title: sneed-and-feed/lean-theorems-1
summary: A complete machine-checked Lean 4 formalization of Lovász's Colorful Helly Theorem (1974 / Bárány 1982). Proves that for any d + 1 finite families of convex sets in R^d such that every colorful transversal has a non-empty intersection, at least one entire family has a non-empty intersection. To the maintainers' knowledge, the theorem was not found in an exact declaration name, docstring, and type signature search of the pinned Mathlib revision (Mathlib v4.34.0-rc1).

review.reason: Lean formalization of Lovász's colorful Helly theorem for convex sets.
